name: SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd
title: SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd - 543066 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Credit cards: credit cost falling (7.7% gross, down 55bps QoQ) and GNPA 2.41%, but receivables growth only 2% YoY, revolver on downward bias, and cost-to-income guided 55-58%.

triggers.label: Credit cost 7.7%, down 55bps QoQ
triggers.quote: our gross credit cost has improved by 55 basis points quarter-over-quarter to 7.7%

triggers.label: Receivables growth only 2% YoY
triggers.quote: our receivables were at INR56,926 crores, around 2% growth Y-o-Y

triggers.label: Revolve rate slight downward bias in FY27
triggers.quote: we expect this to have a slight downward bias in FY '27

guidance.quote: we expect the cost to income to be in the range of 55% to 58% for the next year as well
We expect the credit cost to moderate further in FY '27.
We expect NIM to remain stable, though at risk from any significant increase in cost of fund
We look at the next quarter acquisition to be somewhere in the similar range.
we are aiming towards 4% to 4.5% of ROA in the medium term

prior_guidance_check.metric: Card acquisition 9 lakh to 1 million per quarter
prior_guidance_check.quote: we have ended this quarter with around 9.17 lakhs. So we are on track

red_flags.label: Receivables growth 2% YoY
red_flags.quote: our receivables were at INR56,926 crores, around 2% growth Y-o-Y

red_flags.label: Q4 other income boosted by one-offs
red_flags.quote: this year in the other income, there have been some one-offs as well

red_flags.label: Management overlay retained at INR220 crores
red_flags.quote: we are retaining an overlay of INR220 crores for ECL provision

evasions.quote: right now, we are not giving any guidance on asset growth
it's too early for me to give you any kind of an indication for the full year

evasions.topic: PL on CC split in EMI pool
evasions.quote: we have never given the breakup of PL on CC
